description: GENERATORS — music you do not have to write. BAND generators (has: ["band"] — jazz …; more genres are added without a release) write a WHOLE arranged piece in a genre: every part's notes (drums, bass, piano, a lead), its form and changes, for a seed. With generator + bars | seconds, bpm, key, seed, lead ("none" = rhythm section alone) → parts[] ({name, instrument, timbre_preset, notes}), form, changes and the .mid (midi_base64): free, instant, no audio. To HEAR it: doseedo_render_score {generator: {id, seed, bars, key, lead}, bpm} plays that exact piece — you pass no notes. A film cue or a song that calls for a generator's genre should use it rather than be composed. DRUM generators — ready-made kits and grooves: each generator is a KIT (recorded one-shots for a genre: doseedo_render_midi plays your drum notes through it when the part's drum_genre names it), a LOOP (a groove written for a seed: doseedo_generate_loop → the audio + its MIDI), or both (house, deep house, tech house, afro house, jackin' house — the list grows without a release, so read it rather than remember it). No args → every generator: id, what it has, the drum_genre words that reach its kit, its loop's tempo, swing and bars. With generator (+ bars, bpm, seed, swing, fills, percussion) → that generator's loop AS MIDI: notes[] [{pitch, start_beats, duration_beats, velocity}] (GM drums) and the .mid (midi_base64) — the SAME groove doseedo_generate_loop plays for that seed, instant, free, no audio: read a few seeds, pick or edit one, then render it (doseedo_generate_loop with the same seed, or doseedo_render_midi with your edited notes) or put it on a session track (set_midi_notes). Read-only, no key needed.

bpm.description: Tempo written into the .mid, 40–240 (default: the generator's).

direction.description: A BAND generator: what you want of the piece, as doseedo_render_score's generator takes it — {dynamics: [{at_seconds, level: none|low|medium|high|peak}], hits: [{at_seconds, strength?}], lay_out: [{from_seconds, to_seconds}], intro: false}. Times in seconds at this bpm, or at_beats / from_beats / to_beats.

fills.description: false = no fills at the phrase ends.

generator.description: A generator id ("deep_house") or genre words ("afro house") → its loop as MIDI. Omit to list the generators.

key.description: A BAND generator: the key, e.g. "F", "C minor" (default: drawn by the seed).

lead.description: A BAND generator: the lead instrument (one of its leads), or "none" for the rhythm section alone.

percussion.description: Percussion voices, 0–4 (default: drawn by the seed).

seconds.description: A BAND generator: the piece's length in seconds (4–600) instead of bars — a film cue's duration.

seed.description: Which groove: the same seed is the same pattern (default 1).

name: doseedo_generators
title: Generators (a band's whole piece in a genre; drum kits, grooves, loop MIDI)
